The CD limit of detection for *L. monocytogenes* is **0.0123**, shown in Fig. S17c (page 6). The paper gives this in OD600 units, the same as the other LODs in that section.

The UV–vis LOD for the same bacterium was 0.0125 (Fig. S17d), so CD gives only a slight improvement here. For comparison, *P. aeruginosa* had a CD LOD of OD600 = 0.0034 versus 0.0066 by UV–vis (page 6).
question: What is the CD limit of detection for L. monocytogenes?
